name: @gemstack/skill-orchestration
description: Orchestration as a skill: a main agent plans its task, starts subagents on the parts once the person approved the plan, each a run of its own on a branch started from the main agent's, and lists them, reads their results, stops them and lands their work with the orchestration command.

scripts.prepack: node -e "if(!process.env.npm_config_user_agent?.startsWith('pnpm/')){console.error('Pack and publish with pnpm: it replaces workspace:* with the real version, npm does not');process.exit(1)}"
